updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to download webinar registration details from the Events app in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to download webinar registration details from the Events app in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, this impacts users who have the AllowEngagementReport meeting policy set to Off, as they're unable to download webinar registration details in Microsoft Teams Events because the Download option does not appear.

Current status: We've received reports from affected users that users may be unable to download webinar registration details in Microsoft Teams Events when the AllowEngagementReport meeting policy is set to Off. We're reviewing recent feature updates to the service to isolate the source of this issue and identify appropriate remediation actions.

Scope of impact: Impact may occur for users whose assigned meeting policy has AllowEngagementReport set to Off, preventing them from downloading webinar registration details from the Events app in Microsoft Teams. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 8:00 PM UTC
